scenes.voiceover: What does it actually cost an Indian family to stay in America today?
scenes.image_prompt: Hook — immigration forms with dollar bills and question mark

scenes.voiceover: One hundred thousand dollars. That's the new price tag on a single H-1B petition.
scenes.image_prompt: $100,000 H-1B petition fee reveal with Capitol silhouette

scenes.voiceover: Add a two-fifty integrity fee per person, a one percent remittance tax, and a quadrupled border fee.
scenes.image_prompt: Stacking fee blocks — $250 integrity, 1% remittance, $24 I-94

scenes.voiceover: A Bay Area engineer with two dependents now pays over six figures — before even starting a green card.
scenes.image_prompt: Itemized family bill showing 3-year H-1B costs exceeding six figures

scenes.voiceover: The government expects twenty-nine billion dollars from visa integrity fees alone — over ten years.
scenes.image_prompt: $28.9 billion projected visa fee revenue 2025-2034 with revenue chart

scenes.voiceover: H-1B workers at India's top IT firms nearly halved — from thirty-four thousand to eighteen thousand.
scenes.image_prompt: Before-after bar chart — 34,507 (2017) vs 17,997 (2025) H-1B workers

scenes.voiceover: When the cost of staying outweighs the dream, Bangalore stops being the fallback — it becomes the plan.
scenes.image_prompt: Split screen — US visa stress vs vibrant Bangalore GCC office boom
